workspace.title: Root generated artifacts are absent
workspace.test: The repository should not keep stale root build output, Turbo cache, Yarn install cache, or runtime Docker volume contents as working tree artifacts after the monorepo migration.

steps.instruction: Inspect root generated paths after cleanup.
steps.expected: Root dist, .turbo, .yarn/install-state.gz, .yarn/unplugged, and non-.gitkeep docker/volume files are absent from the working tree.
steps.descript: Generated root artifacts and runtime volume contents were absent after cleanup.
evidence: Command: for p in dist .turbo .yarn/install-state.gz .yarn/unplugged; do test ! -e "$p" && echo "absent $p"; done
Observed: absent dist, absent .turbo, absent .yarn/install-state.gz, absent .yarn/unplugged.
Command: find docker/volume -mindepth 2 -type f -o -type d | sort
Observed: only docker/volume/home-ndx/.gitkeep and docker/volume/workspace/.gitkeep.

steps.descript: Both Docker volume placeholders remain tracked.
evidence: Command: git ls-files docker/volume/home-ndx/.gitkeep docker/volume/workspace/.gitkeep
Observed: docker/volume/home-ndx/.gitkeep and docker/volume/workspace/.gitkeep.

workspace.title: Legacy root src is absent
workspace.test: The old root src tree should be gone because all source now lives under apps/* and packages/ndx.

steps.expected: src does not exist at repository root.
steps.descript: The legacy root src path is absent.
evidence: Command: test -e src && echo exists src || echo absent src
Observed output: absent src.

steps.descript: All expected workspace source roots exist.
evidence: Command: for p in apps/ndx/src apps/ndxserver/src packages/ndx/src; do test -e "$p" && echo "exists $p"; done
Observed: exists apps/ndx/src, exists apps/ndxserver/src, exists packages/ndx/src.

tracked-tests.title: Legacy tests directory is removed
tracked-tests.test: The tracked tests directory still imports ../src and conflicts with the agenttest-only policy, so it should be removed from the monorepo tree.

steps.instruction: Inspect Git-tracked tests paths after cleanup.
steps.expected: git ls-files tests returns no files.
steps.descript: No Git-tracked files remain under tests.
evidence: Command: git ls-files tests | wc -l
Observed output: 0.

steps.expected: test/20260507 contains the monorepo cleanup suite and previous strict JSON report artifacts.
steps.descript: The active test directory contains both previous monorepo evidence and the cleanup suite.
evidence: Command: find test/20260507 -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort
Observed: 011454_monorepo-refactor.json, 011454_report.json, 011454_summary.md, 124110_monorepo-cleanup.json.

documentation.title: Cleanup policy is documented
documentation.test: Repository documentation should describe the monorepo cleanup boundaries so stale root src, dist, tests, and runtime volume contents do not reappear.

steps.expected: docs/testing.md states that test/ is the authoritative path and tests/ must not be used.
steps.descript: Testing docs now record the test/ policy and generated artifact boundaries.
evidence: docs/testing.md contains: Use test/YYYYMMDD/HHMMSS_*.json for suites.
docs/testing.md contains: Do not create or restore root tests/, tests/plans, or tests/reports.
docs/testing.md documents root dist, .turbo, .yarn/unplugged, .yarn/install-state.gz, and Docker volume cleanup boundaries.

steps.expected: Documentation records that source lives under apps/* and packages/ndx and root src/dist are not source-owned paths.
steps.descript: Internals docs now distinguish workspace source roots from stale root paths.
evidence: docs/internals.md states root src, root dist, and root tests are not source-owned monorepo paths.
docs/internals.md states source belongs under apps/*/src or packages/ndx/src.
docs/usage.md path-mapping example now uses test/20260507 instead of tests/reports.

verification.title: Workspace builds after cleanup
verification.test: Removing leftovers must not break the Turbo monorepo build.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable and yarn build.
steps.expected: Both commands exit successfully and Turbo reports successful package builds.
steps.descript: Install and Turbo build succeeded after cleanup.
evidence: Command: yarn install --immutable && yarn build
Yarn 4.14.1 completed with only the known PnP ESM loader warning.
Turbo 2.9.9 reported Tasks: 4 successful, 4 total for @neurondev/ndx, @neurondev/ndx-core, @neurondev/ndx-toolcontainer, and @neurondev/ndxserver-app.

steps.instruction: Run the compiled ndx and ndxserver version commands.
steps.descript: Compiled app wrapper bins reported the expected version.
evidence: Command: node apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndx.js --version
Command: node apps/ndx/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version
Command: node apps/ndxserver/dist/bin/ndxserver.js --version
Observed output: 0.1.39 for all three commands.
